reels.title: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation

editorial_notes.reasoning: This topic aligns with the 'agentic' frontier which is highly relevant to developers. It offers a unique visual opportunity to animate how modular agent skills are 'donated' or compiled into a shared framework, fitting the 3b1b aesthetic of assembling complex systems.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if your AI assistant could 'inherit' professional skills from a global repository just like software libraries?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: An 'app store for expert intuition'—imagine plugging a module of 'legal reasoning' into an agent the way you insert a new lens into a camera.
